newsitem.title: USA: Cadbury's Dr Pepper enters settlement.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury's Dr Pepper enters settlement.

text.p: Dr Pepper/Seven Up Inc said on Wednesday that it and Swire Pacific Holdings Inc. reached a settlement of all outstanding litigation between the two companies over licensing agreements.
Dr Pepper/Seven Up Inc and Swire were parties to three separate actions pending in Texas and Idaho state courts, the company said.
Under the terms of the settlement, all those actions will come to an end and no value will be paid in connection with the termination of the litigation, the company said.
By termination of the litigation, Swire has withdrawn its challenges to Dr Pepper/Seven Up Inc's right to unilaterally approve a transfer of its license agreements to other bottlers, Dr. Pepper said.

Also, Swire has withdrawn a challenge to Dr Pepper/Seven Up Inc's enforcement of its license agreement prohibition on a bottler simultaneously distributing Sprite brand products in an area covered by the bottler's Seven Up license agreement.
